info.title: Gifted Mind School Portal API
info.description:
Multi-tenant school portal API.

**Authentication.** Log in with `POST /auth/login`; the response sets an httpOnly `session` cookie.
Swagger UI cannot set cookies with the Authorize button, but when `/docs` is served from this API origin,
calling `POST /auth/login` with Try it out sets the cookie and later calls carry it.

**Authorization.** Every school-scoped endpoint takes its school from the session, never from the request.
Route guards check a permission; service guards additionally require a strictly higher role rank than the
target. Granting a role requires the role to be ranked below you **and** to grant only permissions you hold.
Each operation's description states its permission and rank rule.

**Errors.** Every failure uses `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. Cross-school IDs return the same
`404` as nonexistent ones. `401` is used both for a missing session and for failed login; the body never
distinguishes an unknown email from a wrong password.

**Pagination.** List endpoints use either `{ data, page: { limit, offset, total } }` or, for the audit log,
`{ data, nextCursor }` with an opaque cursor.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login, logout, password change, and the current identity. Login is email + password only; a user with several active memberships gets a school picker before a session is created.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Members of the caller's school. Every `:id` is a **membership** ID, never a global user ID. Requires `users:*` permissions; destructive actions also require a strictly higher rank than the target.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Per-school roles and their permission grants. Requires `roles:read`, `roles:assign`, or `roles:manage_permissions`. The owner role is locked.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Append-only, school-scoped audit history. Requires `audit:read`. Cursor-paginated by `(created_at, id)`.

session.name: session
session.description: Opaque session cookie set by `POST /auth/login`. httpOnly; the raw token is never exposed to JavaScript. Log in via Swagger UI first, then use Try it out.

roles.description: Role keys held at the active school

permissions.description: Effective permission set (union of all roles)

temporaryPassword.description: Present only when a NEW user was created. Absent when an existing user was linked to this school. Known low-severity enumeration vector; see SECURITY.md.

id.description: Membership ID (not the global user ID)

roles.description: Role keys held at this school

rank.description: 1–100; higher is more authority. The client uses this to hide unassignable roles.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page. Encodes microsecond-precision `created_at` + id, so pages have no gaps or duplicates.

name.description: Actor's name, or `System` for platform actions

post.description: Email + password only. On success a `session` cookie is set and the response has `kind: success`. If the user has more than one active membership and no `schoolSlug` is supplied, no session is created: the response has `kind: select_school` and the client retries with a slug. Every failure returns the same `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS` body, and unknown emails are verified against a dummy hash so response time does not reveal whether the account exists.

schoolSlug.description: Only needed when the same email belongs to several schools. Omit it on the first call; if the user has more than one active membership the response is `kind: select_school`, and the client retries with a slug.

200.description: Session created (`kind: success`) or a school picker (`kind: select_school`, no session).

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive user, or no active membership.

429.description: More than 5 failed attempts from this IP in 15 minutes.

post.description: Deletes the current session row and clears the cookie. Allowed even when `mustChangePassword` is set. Idempotent: no session cookie is not an error from the client's perspective (the route still requires a live session).

Requires the **current** password, not just a session — a stolen cookie cannot change the password. On success `mustChangePassword` is cleared and every other session of this user is deleted. This route is reachable while `mustChangePassword` is set.

newPassword.description: At least 10 characters; must differ from the current password

400.description: Same password, no password set, or validation failure.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the current password is wrong.

get.summary: Current identity, school, roles, and permissions
get.description: Everything the client needs to render the session: the user, the active school, role keys, the effective permission set (union of all roles), and whether a password change is required. Allowed while `mustChangePassword` is set so the frontend can detect the state.

post.summary: Invite a member to this school
post.description: Requires `users:create`. Creates a user (returning a one-time `temporaryPassword`) or links an existing user to this school without one. Every requested role must be ranked strictly below the caller and grant only permissions the caller holds. At least one of `email` or `username` is required. The actor cannot assign a role at or above their own rank. Body is `.strict()`: unknown fields are rejected.

400.description: Validation failure, or a role key that does not exist at this school (`UNKNOWN_ROLE`).

403.description: Missing `users:create`, or a role the caller cannot assign.

409.description: Already a member (`ALREADY_MEMBER`) or username taken at this school (`USERNAME_TAKEN`).

get.description: Requires `users:read`. Offset-paginated; `limit` is clamped to 100 by the server. Ordered by newest membership first with `id` as a tiebreaker.
Requires `users:read`. `{id}` is a membership ID. A membership in another school returns the same `404 NOT_FOUND` as a nonexistent one — no cross-school probing.

404.description: No such member in this school.

patch.description: Requires `users:update`. Requires a strictly higher rank than the target, and rejects self-targeting (use `/me`). Email changes are refused for users who belong to another school (`SHARED_ACCOUNT`), because one school must not be able to take over an identity used elsewhere.

403.description: Missing `users:update`, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

post.description: Requires `users:reset_password` and a strictly higher rank. Sets a new password, forces a change on next login, and deletes every session of the target. Refused for multi-school users (`SHARED_ACCOUNT`) — only they may change their own password. Self-targeting is rejected; use `/auth/change-password`.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

409.description: The user belongs to another school (`SHARED_ACCOUNT`).

post.summary: Suspend a member at this school
post.description: Requires `users:suspend` and a strictly higher rank. Sets the **membership** status to suspended and deletes sessions whose active membership is this row; sessions at other schools survive. Cannot suspend yourself. Owners cannot be suspended because no rank is strictly above theirs.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

post.description: Requires `users:suspend` (same capability as suspending) and a strictly higher rank. Idempotent: an already-active membership is a no-op. No sessions are created; the member logs in again.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a member
delete.description: Requires `roles:assign` and a strictly higher rank. Self-targeting is rejected. Removing the owner role is guarded by a last-owner check; through the API the self-check and strict rank mean owners cannot remove an owner role at all. Returns 204 even when the member did not hold the role (idempotent, no audit row).

403.description: Missing `roles:assign`, rank too low, self-target, or last owner.

404.description: No such member or role in this school.

get.description: Requires `roles:read`. Returns every role defined for the caller's school, ordered by rank ascending. Roles are per-school rows; the list can differ from another school's. Permission arrays are omitted here and loaded only by the role-detail edit response.

post.summary: Assign a role to a member
post.description: Requires `roles:assign`. `{id}` is a membership ID. The caller must hold a strictly higher rank than the target **and** than the role, and must hold every permission the role grants (you cannot grant a capability you lack). Self-assignment is forbidden. Idempotent: re-assigning a held role is a no-op.

400.description: Validation failure or unknown role key.

403.description: Missing `roles:assign`, rank too low, permission subset violation, or self-target.

404.description: No such member or role in this school.

put.description: Requires `roles:manage_permissions`. The caller must outrank the role. Every permission in the new set must be one the caller holds — otherwise permission editing becomes a privilege-escalation path. Removing permissions is always allowed. The **owner** role is immutable: its permissions always equal the full catalogue, so a school cannot make itself unadministrable. The response includes the updated permissions.

200.description: Updated role with its permission set.

400.description: Unknown permission string, duplicates, or empty set.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, owner role, or granting a permission the caller lacks.

404.description: No such role in this school.

get.summary: List audit rows for this school
get.description: Requires `audit:read`. Newest first, cursor-paginated. Always scoped to the caller's school — another school's rows are not observable. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` to continue. Snapshots are field-picked; password hashes, tokens, IPs, and user agents are never returned. System actions have `actor.name: "System"` and a null `actor.membershipId`.

200.description: A page of audit rows and the next cursor.

400.description: Unknown query parameter (`VALIDATION_ERROR`) or malformed cursor (`INVALID_CURSOR`).

get.description: Returns 200 while the process is accepting requests. It does not query the database; a deploy check that needs readiness should verify a data-backed endpoint after login.
